anomalies.observed: In the root-sheet 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block the 22 nF sampling capacitor C5 is tied to label NET0008, while the 1 kΩ series resistor R1 (to A1 pin BTN) is tied to NET0007. On the MCU, NET0007 = PB5 (pin 37, the electrode line, correct) but NET0008 = PB12, which is the DISPLAY sheet symbol's RES# line (DISP_RES). The MCU's TSC sampling pin PB7 (pin 39, labelled NET0006) is not connected to the touch block at all, and NET0006 appears nowhere else in the circuit.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec the TSC sampling capacitor (C14, 22 nF to GND) belongs on the TSC sampling IO PB7 (TSC_G2_IO4), and the display reset line PB12 (DISP_RES) is a separate net with its own 10 kΩ pull-up. The two should never share a net.

evidence.quote: Root sheet, 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)': C5 22n top plate -> NET0008, R1 1k -> NET0007 -> A1(BTN); MCU right column PB5=NET0007, PB7=NET0006 (no touch connection); DISPLAY sheet symbol pin NET0008
TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group
DISP_RES: U2 pin 33 (PB12) — R4 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pin 14 (RES#)

anomalies.impact: The capacitive-touch electrode has no sampling capacitor on its TSC pin (PB7/NET0006 is left floating), so touch sensing will not work; simultaneously the display reset line (PB12/NET0008) is shorted to a 22 nF capacitor to GND, loading and slowing the reset edge and merging two unrelated nets.
